notes.title: Hero Emblems II – 1st Anniversary on Steam!
notes.notes:
[p]Thank you to all the players for your support and companionship over the past year!
[i]Hero Emblems II[/i] is about to celebrate the [b]first anniversary[/b] of its Steam release![/p][p][/p][p]To mark this special occasion, we’re offering an [b]80% OFF limited-time discount[/b].
If you haven’t embarked on this journey yet, now is the perfect time to join the Rune Heroes in their thrilling adventure.
The offer is only available for a short time—don’t miss it![/p][p][/p][p]We’re also excited to announce that the game is now [b]Steam Deck Verified[/b]!
Whether at home or on the go, you can now enjoy smooth gameplay anytime, anywhere.[/p][p][/p][p]Finally, we warmly invite all players to leave your reviews and ratings on our Steam Store page.
If you enjoyed the game, please don’t hesitate to recommend it—your support is our greatest motivation to keep moving forward and delivering new updates![/p][p][/p][p]Thank you once again for being with us, and may our adventure continue for years to come![/p][p][/p][p]— [i]Hero Emblems II Development Team[/i][/p]

notes.title: Facing Challenges: Updates and Apologies for Hero Emblems II
notes.notes:
Dear "Hero Emblems II" Players,

First and foremost, we sincerely apologize for the bugs and balance issues within the game that have led to an unpleasant experience for many of you, particularly those who were highly anticipating our game. We are truly sorry for the disappointment our results have caused.

We have resolved some of the bugs, but we must admit that some issues are difficult to reproduce and fix. If you encounter crashes or any issues with smooth gameplay, please report them in our forum, including details of your computer's specs (OS, CPU, GPU, RAM) and input devices (keyboard/mouse/gamepad). We apologize for any poor gaming experience caused by these bugs and are doing our best to address them. We ask for your continued patience.

As for the game's design and balance issues, particularly the excessive debuffs which many players found frustrating, we apologize once again! We've made necessary adjustments, such as ensuring that hard-earned magic emblems are no longer overridden by debuffs, and we've tweaked the quantity of debuffs and enemy HP to better balance the fun and challenge of the game.

We sincerely invite all players to revisit the improved "Hero Emblems II" and hope you can appreciate the efforts we have made to enhance the game quality.

Our team is committed to making "Hero Emblems II" better and meeting your expectations. We hope to continue receiving your support, whether through positive or negative feedback; we want to hear from you to understand what we have done right and where we need to improve.

Thank you again for your patience and support, and we look forward to having you join us again in the adventure world of "Hero Emblems II".

Best regards, 
HeatPot Games

notes.title: Hero Emblems II Release Date Confirmed
notes.notes:
Check out the latest trailer first!
[previewyoutube=bgWR-I3czPE;full][/previewyoutube]
We are thrilled to announce that the PC version of Hero Emblems II will officially launch on Steam on August 6th!

Get ready for an exciting match-3 RPG adventure! Whether you’ve played the iOS version or are new to the game, join us and enjoy the fun and challenges!

Thank you to all the players who gave feedback and suggestions. Your input helped us improve the game for a better experience at launch. 

Don’t forget to add Hero Emblems II to your Steam wishlist and share this great news with your friends! 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2417940/

Thanks for your support and please stay tuned!
Let’s look forward to the release on August 6th together!🚀🌟
